description: Defines an abstract class 'Tensor' representing tensor objects similar to PyTorch, including methods for buffer allocation, tensor creation from various data types, and internal data management. Contains nested classes for specific tensor data types and native interop methods.

classes.name: Tensor
classes.description: Abstract class representing a tensor with methods for creation, data access, and native interop. Contains nested classes for specific data types (e.g., Tensor_uint8, Tensor_int8, Tensor_int32, Tensor_float32, Tensor_int64, Tensor_float64).

methods.name: allocateByteBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a direct ByteBuffer with native byte order for a given number of elements.

methods.name: allocateIntBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a direct IntBuffer with native byte order for a given number of elements.

methods.name: allocateFloatBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a direct FloatBuffer with native byte order for a given number of elements.

methods.name: allocateLongBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a direct LongBuffer with native byte order for a given number of elements.

methods.name: allocateDoubleBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a direct DoubleBuffer with native byte order for a given number of elements.

methods.name: fromBlobUnsigned
methods.description: Creates a UINT8 tensor from a byte array, shape, and optional memory format.

methods.name: fromBlob
methods.description: Creates tensors from byte array, int array, float array, long array, or double array, with optional memory format.

methods.name: fromBlobUnsigned
methods.description: Creates a UINT8 tensor from a ByteBuffer with native byte order and shape.

methods.name: fromBlob
methods.description: Creates a tensor from a ByteBuffer with native byte order and shape.

methods.name: fromBlob
methods.description: Creates a tensor from an IntBuffer with native byte order and shape.

methods.name: fromBlob
methods.description: Creates a tensor from a FloatBuffer with native byte order and shape.

methods.name: fromBlob
methods.description: Creates a tensor from a LongBuffer with native byte order and shape.

methods.name: fromBlob
methods.description: Creates a tensor from a DoubleBuffer with native byte order and shape.

methods.name: numel
methods.description: Calculates total number of elements for a given shape array.

methods.name: shape
methods.description: Returns a copy of the tensor's shape array.

methods.name: dtype
methods.description: Abstract method to return the data type of the tensor.
